abilities._comment: 'Your attack action cards played from arsenal and weapon attacks have -1{p}.' This carried a TODO saying the static was not expressible; it is, and has been for a while -- every piece already existed. ATTACK_CONTROLLED_BY_YOU is the load-bearing one: the RECALC_ATTACK_POWER bridge (engine._dsl_recalc_listener) dispatches to permanents belonging to BOTH players, so without it a Frailty in the DEFENDER's arena would shrink the attacker's attack. ATTACK_PLAYED_FROM_ZONE asks about the card currently attacking, unlike PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL, which asks about the ability's SOURCE -- here the token itself, which was never played from anywhere. Found by replaying real attacks (scripts/talishar_attack_replay.py): 13 of the 25 remaining power disagreements were this, on cards like millers_grindstone (a weapon attack) and leave_no_witnesses_red (played from arsenal).
